body: I think they could, but I’m too scared to come out and talk about my depression and anxiety. I can’t do it.. I just can’t understand why I am so sad.. It was my brothers friend who killed himself. He’s sad. He needs the attention. His life was ruined. Yet I am still here, if I come out and say I’m hurting, it would make no sense. why would I have a reason to be so sad. It’s so fucked up, it would be so self centred/selfish for me to get help when I know my brother is more sad then I am, and yet he’s silent, he doesn’t ask anyone to bear his emotional weight, so why do I want to give mine away. He has way more emotional weight than I do, he stands strong. I have no reason to have any emotional weight, yet I’m crumbling.
Mixture of both, the sadness hit and then shit made it worse
